THE LIBRARY'S ENGINES (level 1 takes one as it is, with the reads and writes shown):
- Check: a website: the pages checked against the owner's rules and put together as a build (reads Pages, writes Build)
- Do: any goal the Library has no line for: what was asked, done as one written answer and filed as the Result (reads Brief, writes Result)
- Plan: a website: the pages a site will have, from the brief (reads Brief, writes Site plan)
- Publish: a website: a checked build put live where the owner said (reads Build, writes Live site)
- Write: a website: every page written from the plan (reads Site plan, writes Pages)
THE LIBRARY'S ARTIFACTS:
- Brief: the owner's words for a department: its goal and every ask since
- Site plan: the pages a site will have, from the Brief
- Pages: the body of every page the plan names
- Build: every page in one layout, checked
- Live site: the site as served, at its address
- Result: what a department answered, filed
THIS KIND OF DEPARTMENT REQUIRES THESE ENGINES, each kept at level 1 (what its check refuses is shown):
- Check: a website: the pages checked against the owner's rules and put together as a build; it refuses a page with a script, a link to no page, a page with almost no text, a page that breaks one of the owner's rules
